name: handoff-codex
description: Automatically monitors Codex conversation context and triggers a concise handoff before auto compact.

interface.shortDescription: Auto handoff for long Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: Handoff Codex watches Codex Stop token usage before the auto compact limit and uses PreCompact as a final safety net before Codex compacts the session.
defaultPrompt: Use $handoff-codex to create a handoff for this session.
Explain how Handoff Codex will trigger handoffs.
